title: MishkaCMS component showcase
description: Hand-authored drop default and finished examples for one component of a UI kit. Laid over the harvested examples by MishkaChelekom.CmsBundle.Showcase. See README.md in this directory for the full contract.

name.description: The component this attaches to, including the kit prefix — e.g. "chelekom-card". Must match a component name in the bundle exactly, or the file is ignored.

furnishing.description: What lands on a plain drag-and-drop, when the reader has opened neither the examples modal nor the wizard. Uses the component's DEFAULT options only — a minimal install ships nothing else, and a drop must never render as an error. Validated on the consumer side by MishkaCmsCore.Builder.Furnishing.

body.description: HEEx written between the component's tags. An empty string means genuinely empty and is honoured — a spinner has nothing to say. Never write <:inner_block>; the HEEx compiler rejects the name.

slots.description: Sample <:name> entries, for a component whose content is a list. Repeat a slot name to place several entries.

name.description: A slot the component declares. Never "inner_block" — that is `body`.

body.description: HEEx written inside this slot entry.

attrs.description: The slot's OWN attributes, written verbatim. An <:option> without a `value` is a choice that cannot be chosen.

examples.description: Finished, real-world blocks a reader can insert and edit. Three to five — not one per variant, which is what the wizard tab already answers, better and with a live preview.

label.description: What the block IS, never what option it sets. "Pricing card with feature list", not "Outline variant".
examples: Cookie consent bar with accept and decline

source.description: Complete, self-contained HEEx in the CMS runtime form — <.component component_name="…" site="Global" …>, including every nested child. Only declared attributes and slots; only option values present in the component's helpers[].discriminators; required attributes supplied and ids literal and unique. No daisyUI, no style= or <style>, no :let, no phx- handlers needing their own LiveView, no invented image URLs. The bundle's `requires` is DERIVED from this markup — you do not declare it.
